main.description: Whether tiles may play in mu. Written by the brand's admin account (the creator of its trusted-verifier list) and read by every client when a tile is about to play, so flipping it reaches running apps within a minute without a release. Absent, tiles play. Stored as a singleton at rkey 'self'.

enabled.description: Whether tiles may play. False pauses every tile everywhere: cards stop offering to play, running tiles come down, and none can be attached to a post.

message.description: Shown on tile cards while paused, e.g. why.
